components.name: Add Tessellation Pattern
components.description: Creates custom tessellation patterns by copying a base module geometry across an area using origin, U, and V points as copy vectors. Generates a 3x3 preview before full tessellation.
components.usage: For creating fully custom paving patterns with precise control. Tessellation geometry must include manual seam spacing. Origin point + U point (horizontal vector) + V point (vertical vector) define how the module copies across. Point of Beginning controls where pattern starts generating (important for geometry far from Rhino origin 0,0,0). Use Layer pipeline when pulling geo data.

inputs.name: <A>
inputs.description: area to add the tessellation pattern to

inputs.name: POB
inputs.description: point of beginning for pattern generation - controls where tessellation starts. Defaults to Rhino origin (0,0,0). Critical for geometry far from origin to ensure pattern generates correctly. Add explicit POB if pattern fails for distant geometry.

inputs.name: tess geo
inputs.description: closed curves or trim flat surfaces defining the tessellation module - must include manual seam spacing between pavers. Seams are NOT generated automatically; they must be part of your geometry.

inputs.name: origin
inputs.description: start point of the tessellation local to the input module

inputs.name: u point
inputs.description: horizontal copy vector point - offset from origin determines how far geometry copies in X direction (generally used for horizontal tessellation spacing, includes manual seam spacing)

inputs.name: v point
inputs.description: vertical copy vector point - offset from origin determines how far geometry copies in Y direction (generally used for vertical tessellation spacing, includes manual seam spacing)

inputs.name: rotation
inputs.description: Number of degrees to rotate the pattern around the POB. Default = 0

outputs.name: pavers
outputs.description: paver outlines if you need them already

outputs.name: tess preview
outputs.description: A preview to show how the tessellation is working.

components.name: Sculpt Topo Mod
components.description: adjusts topography elevations in relation to height parameter and distance to inputs
components.usage: For sculpting and reshaping terrain features with push and pull operations. Use for landform design and terrain sculpting. Each geometry pushes or pulls the terrain.

inputs.name: <T>
inputs.description: Topo instance with existing mesh data

inputs.name: boundaries
inputs.description: Optional boundaries for sculpting topo areas

inputs.name: geometry
inputs.description: Geometry to grade from. Actual elevation does not matter.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: height from original topo. Can be assigned per attractor. Default >>

inputs.name: spread
inputs.description: width of sculpting not including offset. Can be assigned per attractor. Default >>

inputs.name: offset
inputs.description: Offset from geometry or features before spread begins. Can be assigned per attractor. Default >>

components.name: Smooth Topo Mod
components.description: modifies topography object by smoothing given areas
components.usage: For smoothing terrain irregularities and rough edges. Use for finishing terrain geometry. Can also be thought of as a selective mesh resampling tool.

inputs.name: <T>
inputs.description: Topo instance

inputs.name: boundaries
inputs.description: Specific boundaries for smoothing topo areas. No boundaries will smooth all topo.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: strength of smoothing. Default = 1.0

inputs.name: iterations
inputs.description: number smoothing iterations. Default = 1

inputs.name: remesh
inputs.description: quad remesh smooth area in Rhino 7+. Default = False

inputs.name: dist tol
inputs.description: distance tolerance of smooth points to topo prior to smoothing. Default >>

inputs.name: spacing tol
inputs.description: spacing tolerance between smooth points. Default >>

components.name: Niche Rule Loose Constraint
components.description: Creates a niche rule that acts like a loose constraint; if any parameters of this sub niche are met, constraint will be met.
components.usage: For niche rule loose constraint operations. Use in relevant design workflows.

inputs.name: <N>
inputs.description: Niche to use as a loose constraint. Constraint met if any constraints in this niche are met.

outputs.name: <NR>
outputs.description: Niche Rule. Treat like a niche. Merge or add.

components.name: Niche Rule Mapped Constraint
components.description: Maps value at location from one analysis layer to another and compares to value on other map.
components.usage: For niche rule mapped constraint operations. Use in relevant design workflows.

inputs.name: map from
inputs.description: Name of analysis layer to map from.

inputs.name: from domain
inputs.description: Domain to map from.

inputs.name: map to
inputs.description: Name of analysis layer to map to.

inputs.name: to domain
inputs.description: Domain to map to.

inputs.name: less than
inputs.description: Whether value being tested would be less than. Greater than if False. Default = True

outputs.name: <NR>
outputs.description: Niche Rule. Should be treated like a niche when applying to plants. Merge or add.

components.name: Paver Texture
components.description: Adds a randomly scaled texture to paver meshes within given scale range. Best with square images.
components.usage: For creating paving patterns and hardscape. Use for surface design and material articulation.

inputs.name: paver meshes
inputs.description: meshes describing pavers

inputs.name: min scale
inputs.description: minimum random scaling. Default >>

inputs.name: max scale
inputs.description: maximum random scaling. Default >>

outputs.name: textured pavers
outputs.description: pavers with randomly scaled and rotated texturing.

components.name: Draw Plant Schedule
components.description: Draws a plant schedule at specified origin. Will save a csv file as well if csv path is given.
components.usage: For placing, selecting, or managing plants. Use when designing planting schemes and vegetation layouts.

inputs.name: <A>
inputs.description: Area instances that have plants. Best to flatten if you want one schedule.

inputs.name: start pt
inputs.description: Point to define the top, left corner of the schedule. Default = 0,0,0

inputs.name: niches
inputs.description: Whether to include niche info in the schedule. Default = False

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Font size for schedule text. Default >>

inputs.name: padding
inputs.description: General padding around items in the schedule. Default >>

inputs.name: csv path
inputs.description: Full path to a csv_file if you want to write to a file.

inputs.name: style
inputs.description: Integer to determine the style of the plant symbol. 0=Circle 1=Glyph 2=Lockup 3=Branching 4=Modern 1

outputs.name: table
outputs.description: grid around text - not implemented yet

outputs.name: text locs
outputs.description: list of text locations to preview

outputs.name: symbols
outputs.description: previews of plant size to preview

components.name: Pull Plants by Name
components.description: Pulls subset of plants from a list by name
components.usage: For placing, selecting, or managing plants. Use when designing planting schemes and vegetation layouts.

inputs.description: List of plant instances, short or long to pull from

inputs.name: names
inputs.description: Names of plants to pull out of the list.

components.name: Project Paver Meshes
components.description: Projects paver meshes to a topo mesh, while keeping them flat
components.usage: For creating paving patterns and hardscape. Use for surface design and material articulation.

inputs.name: paver meshes
inputs.description: pavers described as meshes

inputs.name: topo meshes
inputs.description: Topography described as a mesh or meshes

components.name: Pseudo Niche Parameters
components.description: Creates fake niche paramters based on particularly available analysis layers in an environment.
components.usage: For pseudo niche parameters operations. Use in relevant design workflows.

inputs.name: item list
inputs.description: Will generate parameters for every item in the list.

inputs.name: <E>
inputs.description: Environment with analysis layers added.

inputs.name: layers
inputs.description: Names of layers to include. If no input all layers will be included.

components.name: Pseudo Plant Parameters
components.description: Randomly creates basic plant species parameters for non-existent species.
components.usage: For placing, selecting, or managing plants. Use when designing planting schemes and vegetation layouts.

inputs.name: color lib
inputs.description: List of colors to start from. Creates tints and shades from this library.

inputs.name: min sp
inputs.description: minimum number of species. Default = 5

inputs.name: max sp
inputs.description: Maximum number of species. Default = 10

inputs.name: activate
inputs.description: activate the generator

outputs.name: self spacing
outputs.description: Randomly generated self spacing for a given species

outputs.name: cluster radius
outputs.description: Randomly generated radius for plant clustering upon placement

outputs.name: weight
outputs.description: Randomly generated weight for each species

components.name: Rationalize Pattern
components.description: Given a pattern of paver shapes and colors, in combination with an grid pattern, rationalize pattern.
components.usage: For generating repeating patterns. Use for rational design and modular arrangements.

inputs.name: pattern
inputs.description: paver/pattern shapes as they come out of the draw area pattern component.

inputs.name: colors
inputs.description: color indices as they come out of the draw area pattern component.

inputs.name: grid
inputs.description: Granularity of output percentages. Examples: 5%, 10%, 20%. Default = 10

outputs.name: color index set
outputs.description: List of sorted color indices for reference.

outputs.name: percentages
outputs.description: percentage of each paving color for each grid zone.

outputs.name: colors
outputs.description: test colors to show the application of percentages with random placements.

components.name: Rule Restriction Gradient
components.description: Limits plants in an environment by mapping an attribute range to an analysis layer range
components.usage: For rule restriction gradient operations. Use in relevant design workflows.

inputs.name: <E>
inputs.description: Land Kit Environment

inputs.name: layer
inputs.description: name of layer

inputs.name: layer domain
inputs.description: Domain to map to on given analysis layer

inputs.name: attr name
inputs.description: name of numeric plant attribute

inputs.name: attr domain
inputs.description: Domain of attributes to map to on given analysis layer.

outputs.name: <E>
outputs.description: Environment to add restriction gradient rule to

components.name: Set Age
components.description: Sets the age of the plants in a particular area. Based on max size and 'Growth Rate' data field (And Mature height(.5-100 ft) ('Slow'(5-200yr), 'Moderate'(2-50yr), and 'Rapid'(1-20yr)).
components.usage: For set age operations. Use in relevant design workflows.

inputs.name: <A>
inputs.description: Area with plants whose age you want to set

inputs.name: year
inputs.description: Age in years. Default = 2

outputs.name: <A>
outputs.description: Area with plants with modified values for .radius_current and .height_current

components.name: Contours
components.description: Cut topo mesh contours quickly.
components.usage: For generating contour lines from terrain mesh. Use for contour drawings and topographic visualization.

inputs.name: topo mesh
inputs.description: Mesh describing topography

inputs.name: step
inputs.description: Step size for cutting contours. Default >>

inputs.name: spacing
inputs.description: Input Options determine behavior: Op1.Number describing anno spacing along contour. Op2.Cross-curves

outputs.name: contours
outputs.description: Polylines representing contours cut from the mesh at each elevation.

outputs.name: elevations
outputs.description: Value of each contour elevation in a similar data tree structure

outputs.name: anno planes
outputs.description: Planes for annotation along each contour elevation. If spacing is None, this will be empty.

components.name: Cut+Fill Analysis
components.description: Evaluates and visualizes the topo cut and fill volumes between 2 meshes
components.usage: For calculating cut and fill volumes in grading. Use for earthwork budgeting and cost estimation.

inputs.name: original
inputs.description: Mesh describing original topography

inputs.name: changed
inputs.description: Mesh describing changed topography

inputs.name: cell size
inputs.description: Size of cell to evaluate cut and fill. Default >>

inputs.name: vis depth
inputs.description: Depth of max cut or fill for visualization. Default >>

outputs.name: mesh
outputs.description: Colored mesh according to cut fill. Fill is saturated and Cut is grayscale.

components.name: Elevation Analysis
components.description: Evaluates mesh elevation of vertices and creates a colored mesh.
components.usage: For analyzing elevation ranges and variations. Use for understanding terrain height changes.

inputs.name: topo mesh
inputs.description: Mesh describing topography

inputs.name: colors
inputs.description: Color to tint the gradient. Or to create a gradient with more than one color. Default = Gold

inputs.name: legend step
inputs.description: Step size for the legend steps. Will round down to nearest whole number for each step. Default >>

components.name: Slope Analysis Pieces
components.description: Evaluates mesh slope of each face and groups into separate mesh pieces
components.usage: For breaking terrain into slope categories. Use for slope classification and analysis.

inputs.name: topo mesh
inputs.description: Mesh describing topography

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Steps delineating slope groups. Default = [2, 5, 8.333333, 15, 25, 33, 50]

inputs.name: colors
inputs.description: Colors for each slope groups. Default = Gold gradient

outputs.name: meshes
outputs.description: slope group pieces as separate meshes

outputs.name: domains
outputs.description: domains of the slope zones, i.e. 0 To 2

components.name: Trim Pavers to Area
components.description: Trim pavers in an area to the area border. This can be slower.
components.usage: For cutting and fitting pavers to area boundaries. Use to finalize paver layouts and edge conditions.

inputs.name: <A>
inputs.description: Area for trimming pavers

components.name: Sort Key Values
components.description: Takes a set of keys and values and creates component outputs for each key value pair.
components.usage: For sort key values operations. Use in relevant design workflows.

inputs.name: keys
inputs.description: Input keys. One key for each value. (key-value, layer-geometry, etc)

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: Input values. One value for each key.

outputs.name: outputs
outputs.description: Varies depending on each key input. Outputs are built dynamically.

components.name: Bake+Preview
components.description: Bakes and previews geometry. Replaces geometry baked with the same bake name.
components.usage: For bake+preview operations. Use in relevant design workflows.

inputs.name: geometry
inputs.description: Geometry to bake or preview or both.

inputs.name: layer
inputs.description: Layer name for each piece of geometry or data branch.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: Color for each piece of geometry or data branch.

inputs.name: keys
inputs.description: Keys for each data branch.

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: Values to associate with each key, for each data branch.

inputs.name: bake name
inputs.description: Name to use to keep track of what gets replaced when baking again.

inputs.name: BAKE
inputs.description: Boolean activation. True to bake geometry.
